data.description:
## Story
37fc-6f8d-444d-44bf — As an agent filing a bug automatically, I want detected_by inferred from filing context

## testing_mode: GREEN

## What to do
Create `plugins/dso/scripts/infer-detected-by.sh` with:

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
ALLOWED=(tests review-llm review-human production user-report internal-dogfood other)
case "${DSO_FILING_CONTEXT:-}" in
  mutation-auto-bug)    CHANNEL=tests ;;
  fix-bug-phase-g)      CHANNEL=review-llm ;;
  debug-everything)     CHANNEL=review-llm ;;
  review-human)         CHANNEL=review-human ;;
  production)           CHANNEL=production ;;
  user-report)          CHANNEL=user-report ;;
  internal-dogfood)     CHANNEL=internal-dogfood ;;
  *)                    CHANNEL=other ;;
esac
found=0
for v in "${ALLOWED[@]}"; do [ "$v" = "$CHANNEL" ] && found=1 && break; done
[ "$found" = 1 ] || { echo "infer-detected-by: $CHANNEL not in ALLOWED whitelist" >&2; exit 2; }
printf '%s' "$CHANNEL"
```

Run `chmod +x plugins/dso/scripts/infer-detected-by.sh` immediately after creating the file.

## Verify
Run: bash tests/run-all.sh --runner=bash --test-file=tests/scripts/test-infer-detected-by.sh
Expected: all 10 tests PASS GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: script exists, is executable, outputs one of 7 allowed values
- dd-2: DSO_FILING_CONTEXT=mutation-auto-bug → outputs "tests"
- dd-6: unknown/empty DSO_FILING_CONTEXT → outputs "other" (exit 0)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] File created at plugins/dso/scripts/infer-detected-by.sh
- [ ] chmod +x applied
- [ ] All 10 tests pass GREEN
- [ ] ALLOWED array has exactly 7 values matching the allowed enum
- [ ] Unknown/empty context maps to "other" (not an error)
